quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.description: Hold warning and info alerts during a daily window and send them when it ends if they are still firing. Critical alerts always notify.

rules.title: Alert rules
rules.description: Threshold, crashloop, certificate expiry, scheduled task failure, domain health, and missing backup rules over this app's metrics, restarts, jobs, domains, and backup schedules. Notifies via webhook, Slack, or Discord on a firing/resolved transition.
rules.emptyDescription: Get notified the moment a metric crosses a threshold or a container starts crashlooping, via webhook, Slack, or Discord.

slo.title: Track a {{target}}% availability SLO
slo.detail: This app is serving traffic and has no SLO alert. A {{target}}% target pages you when the 30 day error budget burns fast and opens a ticket-level alert when it burns slowly.
slo.noChannel: No notification channel is connected yet, so the rule will only show in alert history until you attach one.
